beats.say: Patrick Stewart has passed away at the age of 86.
Born in Mirfield in 1940, he lived through nearly nine decades of modern culture.
His definitive role came as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek, running seven seasons from 1987 to 1994.
Queen Elizabeth II later knighted him in 2010 for his dedicated services to drama.
His screen legacy endures across generations of television viewers. Quickplay Film stories arrive every single day, so subscribe to stay connected. Remember...

facts: Sir Patrick Stewart died on 28 October 2026 at the age of 86.
Patrick Stewart played Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation from 1987 to 1994.
Patrick Stewart was born on 13 July 1940 in Mirfield.
Patrick Stewart was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010.
